name: Radiant Oath

source.title: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide

text:
You swore to fight evil and protect what kindness remains in Golarion. The Radiant Oath supports you and stands by your side.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Spirit Lore skill. You gain the No Cause for Alarm skill feat.
